'''Target drones''' were used by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to distract the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces blockade on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Harix]] and allow him along with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and a large fleet of freighters to land on the planet undetected. Each individual [[Drone/Legends|drone]] was modified to project a false signature of itself and as a result it would show up on most [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] as a ship much larger than it actually was.

Some targeting drones were manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
